## THE PANEL GAP — why Act VII cannot be played yet

**All six Act VII tabs are still placeholders.** `OpsPanel`, `FabPanel`, `SitesPanel`, `LaunchPanel`,
`ArtifactsPanel` and `ContractsPanel` each render `<PlaceholderPanel>`, whose body is the string
"This panel is not built yet." STORY-021 shipped the shell, the routing and the six stubs and said
in as many words that it owned the routing and deliberately not the contents.

A player entering Act VII today gets the teardown overlay, the frozen-league header, the event feed
and the shell-level click earning Salvage — with **no way to spend it**, because the fabrication
shop has no panel. A complete, well-tested economy that nothing renders.

**§6.8 Visual identity was also never sliced.** Nothing in `src/` references `--v7-bg`,
`body.expedition` or any phase pill, so Act VII currently looks exactly like the ballpark it just
tore down.

**Sliced 2026-08-16 as STORY-034…040.** Seven stories close both gaps.

## Wave plan

**034 must land first.** `styles/global.css` ends inside an `@media (max-width: 640px)` block, so an
appended rule is silently desktop-invisible — a wrong resolution builds clean and looks right in the
diff (MERGE-NOTES Phase 2, hazard 3; STORY-022 and STORY-023 both hit it). 034 owns the single
`body.expedition` section every later panel story extends. Running the panels in parallel with it
produces a four-way conflict on the one file whose failure mode is invisible.

| Wave | Stories | Gate |
|---|---|---|
| **A** | **034** visual identity | none — start here |
| **B** | 035 Ops, 036 Fab, 037 Sites (parallel), **028** launch engine | 034 merged |
| **C** | 038 Artifacts, 039 Launch panel, 030, 031 | #31 merged (038); 028 merged (039) |
| **D** | 040 Contracts panel, 032 | 030 merged (040) |

**036 (Fab) is the story that makes the act playable** — it is the first place Salvage can be spent.
035 + 036 together are the shortest path to something worth trying.

**Engine serialization is unchanged**: 028 needs 027 (merged); 030, 031 and 032 all need 028.
**037 is not blocked by 028 but is inert without it** — until launches exist no site is reached, so
the ladder correctly shows only Home Plate. Build for both states.
